title: Review of c31's crawlers from noise: on fresh seed 6 cells with their own layer form from the random field (s membrane-like in 17/23) and one self-polarizes and crawls, but it grows by absorbing every static cell into a body a third of the box, and no track moves 3 body lengths (labkit max 1.1); the linear twin is static
summary: Re-ran world.py unchanged on fresh seed 6 (80 frames, t=16) and its KIN=1 linear-kinetics twin. From the thresholded random field, curvature flow leaves about a dozen round cells by t~1-2, each with an s ring (aggregate rim/core 4.72, rim/out 8.95; 17/23 individuals membrane-like). One elongated cell polarizes (t~1.4) and crawls as a half-moon, sweeps through the box and absorbs the static disks it meets (t=6-12), ending as one body of 13545 px (occupancy 0.31, components final 2). labkit's longest-moving track reaches 1.1 body lengths because each absorption breaks the track; following the largest body over frames without absorption gives a 374 px path (3.2 of its final sqrt-area) but only 74 px net in the last 4 time units. The KIN=1 twin keeps one static disk (0 body lengths), as in the claim.

observations.S: rerun/seed6/sheet.png t=0: thresholded random two-phase field over the whole box
observations.I: rerun/seed6/sheet.png t=0.6-6: about a dozen discrete round cells
observations.M: rerun/seed6/sheet.png t=1.4-16: one cell polarizes and crawls; results.txt: 374 px path of the largest body over non-absorbing frames, labkit max 1.1 body lengths

seeds_run.result: S, I, B pass; one crawler that absorbs all others; M below 3 labkit body lengths (1.1)
KIN=1 twin: one static disk, 0 body lengths

verdicts.limitation: M is not established at the gate: the moving cell is not a stable individual but one that grows from about 2000 to 13500 px by absorbing the other cells, so its track breaks at every merger and labkit reaches 1.1 body lengths on seed 6 (the claim's 1.4-3.6 on seeds 0-2). The initial field is already a thresholded two-phase pattern and rho starts near its high state (1 +- 0.2), so the cells form by coarsening of a planted phase split rather than nucleating from a uniform state; acceptable for S, but it is close to planted structure. B rests on the quasi-equilibrium clause (adsorption drift written against phi, source the cell's own protein). I did not run SRC=none.
